caption:
There’s a note sewn into the wedding dress. It’s dated June 1998.

For twenty-two years, Nell has altered other people’s dresses in her Bath workroom and never asked why. Then she opens a seam.

The wedding is nine days away.

Under the Lining is out now in Kindle and paperback. Link in bio. 🧵
